settings.heading: Bayou Blanks vs ShirtSpace
settings.answer: Bayou Blanks is the cheaper way to buy blanks than ShirtSpace. ShirtSpace resells first-quality, brand-name apparel at tiered wholesale that only drops when you buy deep. Bayou sells liquidation overstock by the pack at a flat $1 a unit, the same price on a 4XL as a small, with no account needed to see it.

settings.question: Is Bayou Blanks cheaper than ShirtSpace?
settings.answer: For comparable blanks, yes at the per-unit level. ShirtSpace prices first-quality brand goods on a volume tier, so the lowest price needs a bulk order. Bayou sells liquidation overstock at a flat $1 a unit, the same in every size and pack, so you hit a low per-unit cost without ordering deep.

settings.question: Does ShirtSpace have order minimums?
settings.answer: No. ShirtSpace sells by the piece with no minimum, and so does Bayou — you can buy a single pack. The difference isn't the minimum, it's the price and the model: ShirtSpace resells new brand-name apparel; Bayou passes on liquidation overstock by the pack.

settings.question: Do I need an account to see Bayou's prices?
settings.answer: No. Bayou shows the per-unit price right on the page with no sign-up. ShirtSpace requires a free registration (email and phone) to unlock its wholesale pricing.

settings.question: Does Bayou charge more for plus sizes like 2XL–5XL?
settings.answer: No. Bayou prices every size the same — a 4XL is the same $1/unit as a small. Most brand blanks ShirtSpace carries add a size upcharge starting at 2XL, so extended sizes is where Bayou's gap is widest.

settings.question: What's the catch with liquidation blanks?
settings.answer: The trade for the price is selection. Bayou carries around 85 curated in-stock styles from overstock, not the full brand catalog, so you won't find every brand and color. If you need a specific Bella+Canvas or Gildan style in a specific color, ShirtSpace's catalog is deeper; if you want the lowest per-unit on solid blanks, Bayou wins.

settings.question: ShirtSpace or Bayou — which should I use?
settings.answer: Use ShirtSpace when you need a specific brand, color, or style restocked fast from one of their 14 warehouses. Use Bayou when per-unit price is the priority — especially for extended and plus sizes — and you're fine choosing from a curated set of overstock blanks.
